Class DiscoverModelsTask

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.swing.internal.SwingTask<List<AbstractModel>>
uno.anahata.asi.swing.provider.DiscoverModelsTask
public class DiscoverModelsTask extends SwingTask<List<AbstractModel>>
A specialized background task for discovering AI models from provider remote APIs.

This task queries the provider's live endpoint into cachedApiModels. When running in interactive mode (e.g. triggered by 'Test Connection' or 'Refresh'), it evaluates newly discovered models that are not yet persisted in the local database and prompts the user with an interactive confirmation dialog to add and persist them to disk.
